messages:
maria_cs: Hey team, customer ACME (acct_id: acct_9876) says their daily usage export CSV is missing rows for 2025-11-02 and 2025-11-03. Invoice shows tokens for those days but CSV has zero for the day. Can we triage?

alex.k: thanks, filing here. do we have sample export from customer?

maria_cs: they attached the CSV and a screenshot of the billing dashboard. sending excerpts below.

maria_cs: ```csv
date,total_tokens
2025-11-01,123456
2025-11-02,0
2025-11-03,0
2025-11-04,140123
```

maria_cs: dashboard shows 125k tokens on Nov 2 and 130k on Nov 3. invoice shows combined 255k for those two days.

alex.k: hmm. that pattern feels like a backfill/aggregation lag or a shard replay gone wrong. tagging eng. @raj_m can you check any backfill jobs for raw-usage between Nov 2-4?

raj_m: on it. what's the customer's shard or dataset id?

maria_cs: they included export_id: raw_export_202511. not sure of shard mapping.

raj_m: ok. initial look at export-worker logs for raw_export_202511 shows a prefix-cache hit surge around 2025-11-03T03:00Z followed by a single retry loop on worker-7. could be suppressed emit after cache inconsistency. pulling logs + reprocess history.

eng-ops-bot: Deploy notice: rollout/2025-11-03-agg-fix deployed to prod at 2025-11-03T04:12:23Z by taylor_prod.

alex.k: that deploy matches timeframe. could be a double-write + dedupe rule that ignored rows that came in reprocessed with different hashes.

raj_m: found backfill job id bf-2025-11-04-73. status: completed, but with 412 warnings about "prefix mismatch" for file shard ids [14, 17]. logs show the reprocess skipped emitting records where prefix_hash != live_prefix after a cache swap.

maria_cs: customer wants to know: why did tokens appear on invoice/dashboard but not in CSV?

raj_m: invoice and dashboard read from aggregated billing-rollup table which was updated by the initial ingest before the cache swap. CSV export reads from the per-shard raw_export table which the reprocess later skipped for certain prefixes. so billing had the tokens, export missed them.

alex.k: proposed plan: (1) re-run reprocess with cache-consistent mode for those shard ids, (2) regenerate CSV and send to customer, (3) check dedupe rule and add guard to avoid skipping on prefix mismatch for backfill window, (4) notify billing to avoid double-adjusting invoices.

maria_cs: can you estimate delta? customer is sensitive — potentially charge disputes.

raj_m: looking at agg delta: approx +258,000 tokens across the two days. small monetary delta but needs reconciliation. will run reprocess in dry-run first.

support-notify-bot: Alert created: INC-2025-1197 referenced export_id raw_export_202511. assigned to eng-backfill.

taylor_prod: FYI the rollout had one toggle that enabled fast-prefix-cache; it reduced latency but we didn't fully test backfill semantics. I can flip the toggle and do a targeted reprocess on those shard ids. scheduling maintenance window now.

alex.k: please include repro steps and a small log snippet so CS can explain to customer.

raj_m: repro steps (short):
1) run ingestion for sample payloads against shard 14 with fast-prefix-cache enabled
2) force cache swap by restarting worker process mid-window
3) run backfill reprocess with default settings -> observe skipped emits in logs matching "prefix mismatch"

raj_m: log snippet: ```
2025-11-03T03:05:12Z worker-7 WARN prefix_mismatch: live_prefix=0x7f8a cache_prefix=0x1c3d skipping emit for record id=rec_58877
2025-11-03T03:05:12Z worker-7 INFO reprocess: shard=14 records_skipped=12
```

maria_cs: perfect. I'll prepare a customer-facing note with timeline and ask if they want the corrected CSV before we touch invoices.

taylor_prod: reprocess ran at 2025-11-04T01:20Z in cache-consistent mode. results: emitted 262,131 previously-skipped tokens for shard ids [14,17]. regenerated CSV available.

raj_m: post-reprocess checks: aggregate table unchanged (we never rewind invoicing), but raw_export now includes the missing rows. added integration test for backfill semantics and disabled the fast-prefix-cache toggle for backfill jobs.

maria_cs: sent corrected CSV to customer and explained root cause + mitigation. customer accepted updated CSV and will not dispute invoice; asked for postmortem.

alex.k: filing a short postmortem doc and tracking follow-ups: update backfill tests, add monitoring alert on skipped-emit counts, and document toggle behavior.

maria_cs: thanks everyone. closing out once postmortem link is in INC-2025-1197. :thumbsup:
